            <script>
                require(['jquery', 'headroom', 'jquery-headroom', 'jquery-ui'], function($){
                    $(window).on("load, resize", function(){
                            var offset_height = $('.main-header').outerHeight();
                            $('html').headroom('destroy').removeData('headroom').headroom({offset: offset_height});
                        }).trigger('resize'); 

                    $(function(){

                        $("#tab-calendar").tabs({
                            active: 0
                        });

                        $('.main-header__calendar').click( function cal() {
                            var navdata = ko.dataFor($('.c-navigation__toggle')[0]);
                            navdata.isMenuOpen(false);
                            var getBody = document.getElementsByTagName('BODY');
                            if(getBody[0].classList.contains('mobile-menu-open')){
                                getBody[0].classList.remove('mobile-menu-open');
                            }

                            $('.main-header__calendar-offcanvas').toggleClass('menu-open');
                            $('.main-header__calendar').toggleClass('menu-open');
                            $('body').toggleClass('calendar-menu-open');
                        });

                        $(document).on("click",'.sections-nav a[href*=#]', function(e) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            var target = $(this).attr("href"); 
                            var headerHeight = $(".main-header").height();
                            var scrollToPosition = $(target).offset().top - headerHeight + 5;
                            
                            $('html, body').animate({ 'scrollTop': scrollToPosition }, 600, function(target){
                                setActiveClass();
                            });
                        });

                        $(window).scroll(function() {
                            setActiveClass();
                        }).scroll();

                        $(window).resize(function() {
                            setActiveClass();
                        }).scroll();

                        function setActiveClass(){
                            var scrollDistance = $(window).scrollTop();
                            var scrollHeight = $(document).height();
                            var scrollPosition = $(window).height() + $(window).scrollTop();
                            var headerHeight = $(".main-header").height();
                    
                            // Assign active class to nav links while scolling
                            $('.page-section').each(function(i) {
                                if ($(this).position().top - headerHeight <= scrollDistance) {
                                    $('.sections-nav a.active').removeClass('active');
                                    $('.sections-nav a').eq(i).addClass('active');
                                }
                            });

                            if ((scrollHeight - scrollPosition) / scrollHeight === 0) {
                                $('.sections-nav a').eq(-2).removeClass('active');
                                $('.sections-nav a:last').addClass('active');
                            } 

                            if ((window.innerHeight + window.scrollY) >= document.body.scrollHeight) {
                                $('.sections-nav__wrap').addClass('hidden');
                            } else {
                                $('.sections-nav__wrap').removeClass('hidden');
                            };
                        };
                    });
